description: This file is a shell script that constitutes a test suite for verifying the functionality of a git-cvsserver integration and related version control behaviors. It sets up repositories, performs checkouts, modifications, diffs, and merges, and verifies the correctness of various version control operations.

methods.name: check_start_tree
methods.description: Logs the start of verifying a directory tree checkout.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Verifies that a specific file at a given revision matches expected contents.

methods.name: check_end_tree
methods.description: Verifies the completeness and correctness of the directory tree after checkout.

methods.name: check_end_full_tree
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive verification that the full tree matches the expected state, including git's list-tree output.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Applies a diff to a clone and checks if the specified versions differ accordingly.
